correctness.rationale: For compact forward-invariant \(K\), the continuous surjection \(\Psi:\Delta_{m-1}\times K^m\to\mathcal M_{\le m}(K)\) is equivariant, so factor monotonicity and product additivity give the upper bound. With weights \(a_i=2^{i-1}/(2^m-1)\), distinct subset sums make \(\Phi_m:K^m\to\mathcal M_{\le m}(K)\) injective even when coordinates collide; equivariance then gives a conjugate product subsystem and the matching lower bound. All hypotheses, compactness, and the extended-real case are explicit.

value.rationale: The support-cardinality filtration is canonical in the induced probability-measure system. Computing its entropy exactly shows that finite atomic complexity grows linearly, one base-entropy unit per permitted atom, and explains how the classical full-space entropy explosion is assembled from finite stages. This is a structural theorem rather than a routine numerical instance.
